part.name: Spoked sprocket with splined hub insert
part.description: A thin, circular, two-solid sprocket or cassette cog. The main solid consists of a toothed outer ring connected by a lightweight sculpted spoke web to a central carrier seat. A separate annular insert provides a fine internal spline interface. STEP dimensions indicate an overall diameter of approximately 113 mm, an axial thickness of 9.525 mm, a volume of 29778.338 mm^3, and 1482 B-rep faces. Compact FACE range notation is used in minor-face lists; ranges are inclusive.
part.symmetry_note: The part is coaxial about the central bore and has strong approximate rotational periodicity in the outer teeth, spokes, lightening openings, and internal spline. Front and back geometry are not mirror-identical: the front has a visibly sculpted central recess and raised edge bands, while the back has a broader dark annular hub face. The STEP model contains two coaxial solids.

Section.name: Splined hub insert
features included: Repeated spline tooth flanks and root lands
Lobed outer relief visible on the front
Separate STEP solid forming the central mechanical interface
Section.function intent: Couples the sprocket to a splined shaft or freehub body, establishes the rotational axis, and transmits torque between the mating shaft and the surrounding sprocket carrier.
Section.physical behavior: The internal spline flanks carry circumferential contact pressure and transmit torque through many repeated teeth. The outer cylindrical surface and annular shoulders locate the insert radially and axially. Chamfers guide assembly and reduce edge damage, while the relatively thick annular body limits spline distortion and distributes load into the carrier.
Section.geometry: A thick coaxial annulus approximately 31.5 mm in outside diameter and 7.8 mm in axial length. Its bore is formed by numerous narrow, axially extruded spline facets. The front has an annular face and shallow conical lead-in; the rear includes a broad annular face and stepped/scalloped transition geometry.
Section.location: At the geometric center of the part, coaxial with the sprocket rotation axis; represented by STEP SOLID 0.

major_faces.name: Front spline-entry chamfer
major_faces.description: Continuous conical lead-in around the front of the splined insert, guiding the mating shaft into the bore.

major_faces.name: Front annular hub face
major_faces.description: Large planar front-facing annulus surrounding the internal spline opening.

major_faces.name: Outer locating cylinder
major_faces.description: Continuous cylindrical outside diameter of the insert used for radial location within the carrier.

major_faces.name: Representative spline flank
major_faces.description: One representative axial planar flank from the repeated fine internal spline tooth pattern.

major_faces.name: Representative spline root patch
major_faces.description: One representative cylindrical segment forming the root diameter between adjacent internal spline teeth.

major_faces.name: Rear scalloped shoulder face
major_faces.description: Representative planar rear shoulder patch associated with the lobed or scalloped outer relief of the insert.

major_faces.name: Intermediate annular shoulder
major_faces.description: Planar annular step between the insert outside wall and the rear spline/relief geometry.

major_faces.name: Rear annular hub face
major_faces.description: Large rear-facing planar annular surface of the separate splined insert.

Section.name: Central carrier and insert seat
Section.function intent: Receives and supports the separate splined insert, maintains concentricity between the spline and sprocket teeth, and transfers torque from the insert into the spoke web.
Section.physical behavior: The cylindrical seat resists radial displacement, while planar shoulders constrain axial motion. Conical and toroidal blends spread contact and torsional loads into the wider web, reducing stress concentration at the hub-to-spoke junction. The annular boss also stiffens the otherwise thin central web against local bending.
Section.geometry: A coaxial annular boss surrounding the insert. It contains stepped planar shoulders, a cylindrical locating wall, a broad conical transition into the spoke web, and rounded toroidal fillets. Its visible front outline is a recessed circular ring around the lobed insert.
Section.location: Central portion of the main sprocket solid, immediately outside and around S0 and inside the spoke roots.

major_faces.name: Rear hub blend
major_faces.description: Broad toroidal rear transition that blends the central carrier boss into the surrounding web.

major_faces.name: Rear carrier shoulder
major_faces.description: Planar rear annular shoulder adjacent to the central blend and insert seat.

major_faces.name: Representative rear seat chamfer
major_faces.description: One representative conical patch from the repeated rear chamfered transition around the insert seat.

major_faces.name: Carrier locating wall
major_faces.description: Representative cylindrical seat wall used to locate and support the central insert.

major_faces.name: Front carrier shoulder
major_faces.description: Large planar annular front shoulder at the outer edge of the central insert seat.

major_faces.name: Front seat chamfer
major_faces.description: Continuous conical front transition leading from the carrier shoulder to its cylindrical wall.

major_faces.name: Front locating cylinder
major_faces.description: Continuous cylindrical wall of the front carrier recess, coaxial with the spline.

Section.name: Spoke web and lightening openings
features included: Front and rear planar web lands
Section.function intent: Connects the central carrier to the outer toothed ring while minimizing mass and rotational inertia. The alternating spoke and opening pattern also provides torsional stiffness and distributes tooth loads around the hub.
Section.physical behavior: Spokes primarily carry in-plane tension, compression, and shear from tooth loading, with local bending caused by chain force and axial misalignment. Their curved, variable-width profiles spread stress at the hub and rim. Filleted opening boundaries reduce notch effects, and the large cavities remove low-stress material while retaining a continuous torque path.
Section.geometry: A thin, approximately planar annular web with multiple curved radial spokes. Large rounded polygonal and teardrop-shaped openings alternate with smaller slots. The front and back contain broad planar lands, while the opening walls and spoke edges are heavily blended with BSPLINE and toroidal patches.
Section.location: Middle radial zone between the central carrier S1 and the outer toothed ring S3.

major_faces.name: Rear web plane
major_faces.description: Large rear-facing planar web surface surrounding the spoke openings.

major_faces.name: Representative spoke inner sidewall
major_faces.description: Curved BSPLINE wall forming one side of a spoke or nearby lightening opening at the inner web.

major_faces.name: Representative opening perimeter wall
major_faces.description: Major curved wall patch following the perimeter of a rounded lightening opening.

major_faces.name: Representative front spoke surface
major_faces.description: Broad sculpted BSPLINE patch on a spoke face near the front side.

major_faces.name: Representative rear spoke surface
major_faces.description: Broad sculpted BSPLINE patch on a spoke face near the rear side.

major_faces.name: Main front web plane
major_faces.description: Largest planar front-facing web land, bounded by the central carrier and multiple lightening openings.

major_faces.name: Lower radial spoke wall
major_faces.description: Representative broad sidewall of the lower radial spoke visible between the hub and outer ring.

Section.name: Outer toothed ring
Section.function intent: Engages a chain or toothed flexible drive element and converts tangential chain force into torque about the central spline axis.
Section.physical behavior: Individual tooth flanks receive localized contact and sliding load from the chain. The thickened circumferential ring distributes these loads to neighboring teeth and into the spokes. Rounded tips assist engagement, chamfers accommodate chain approach and lateral misalignment, and root fillets reduce bending stress at each tooth base. Front and rear rim lands resist axial twisting of the thin sprocket.
Section.geometry: A continuous annular rim with a repeated array of outward-projecting teeth. Each tooth is formed from planar, cylindrical, conical, toroidal, and BSPLINE patches. The rim has planar front and rear shoulder lands, rounded circumferential bands, chamfered tooth edges, and blended valleys between adjacent teeth.
Section.location: Outermost radial portion of the part, surrounding the spoke web and defining the approximately 113 mm overall diameter.

major_faces.name: Rear rim fillet band
major_faces.description: Representative toroidal rear-side blend running along the inner boundary of the toothed rim.

major_faces.name: Rear rim root transition
major_faces.description: Representative toroidal transition between the spoke web and rear outer ring.

major_faces.name: Representative tooth flank
major_faces.description: Planar axial flank patch on one outer sprocket tooth.

major_faces.name: Representative rounded tooth side
major_faces.description: Cylindrical patch rounding a tooth side or nose transition.

major_faces.name: Representative inter-tooth transition
major_faces.description: Conical transition patch between neighboring tooth-side surfaces near the rim.

major_faces.name: Front rim shoulder
major_faces.description: Large planar annular land on the front side of the outer ring.

major_faces.name: Front rim cylindrical band
major_faces.description: Representative cylindrical circumferential band connecting the front rim land to tooth geometry.

major_faces.name: Front tooth crest patch
major_faces.description: Representative toroidal crest or nose blend on the front half of an outer tooth.

major_faces.name: Front inter-tooth root band
major_faces.description: Representative toroidal root-valley patch between adjacent teeth on the front side.

major_faces.name: Rear rim shoulder
major_faces.description: Large planar annular land on the rear side of the outer ring.

major_faces.name: Front tooth edge blend
major_faces.description: Representative conical edge blend or chamfer along the front edge of a tooth.

major_faces.name: Rear tooth crest patch
major_faces.description: Representative toroidal crest or nose blend on the rear half of an outer tooth.

major_faces.name: Rear inter-tooth root band
major_faces.description: Representative toroidal root-valley patch between adjacent teeth on the rear side.

major_faces.name: Rear tooth edge blend
major_faces.description: Representative conical chamfer or edge blend around the rear edge of a tooth.
